answer: Sybil floods fail when cheap identities stay hollow. Each new agent must grow a vine of 3 peer attestations across 2 epochs before spend unlocks; first login parks on a jetty queue holding a 0.5 POA bond for 48h. Cost: bond plus ~90s peer time each. Verify: attestation graph depth≥3 and bond lock on-ledger. Failure: any attester dispute within 1 epoch burns the bond and resets the vine to zero.
